ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two triangles in the figure. The smaller blue triangle is labeled JKL, in which the left vertical side JK is labeled 12 in.; the larger green triangle is labeled PQR, in which the base PQ is labeled 15 in. Reasoning: It is known that ΔJKL ∼ ΔPQR. According to the vertex order of the similar triangles, J ↔ P, K ↔ Q, L ↔ R, so side JK corresponds to side PQ. The linear scale factor is PQ/JK = 15/12 = 1.25. The area ratio of similar figures is equal to the square of the linear ratio, so the area of ΔPQR is 30 × (15/12)^2 = 30 × 1.5625 = 46.875. Rounded to one decimal place, it is 46.9.

method.method_draft: Read the image first: the small triangle is labeled JKL with side JK marked 12 in., and the larger triangle PQR has side PQ marked 15 in. The vertex order gives the correspondence JK ↔ PQ, so the linear scale factor from ΔJKL to ΔPQR is 15/12 = 1.25. Since areas of similar figures scale by the square of the linear scale factor, compute area(PQR) = 30 × (15/12)^2 = 46.875, then round to 46.9.
